title: Binance Options Will List Additional BTCUSDT Monthly Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Following the  launch of BTCUSDT Monthly Options  in November 2022, Binance Options will list one additional expiry (2023-03-31) for BTCUSDT Monthly Options on  2023-02-09 at 08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   BTCUSDT Monthly Options are European-style Options contracts. Binance Options will list one additional BTCUSDT Monthly Options expiry on  2023-02-09   08:00 (UTC) , which expires on 2023-03-31.  New BTCUSDT front Month (M) and next Month (M+1) Options contracts will be listed on the last Thursday of every month.  Please note that there will be no new BTCUSDT Monthly Options listings if the new listings’ expiration date coincides with that of an existing BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contract. The existing BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contract will be considered as a monthly expiry instead. A separate announcement will be made for the launch of BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contracts.  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
